title: California Form 8283 — Noncash Charitable Contributions — 2024
rationale: A noncash charitable contribution of appreciated stock with a claimed value of $15,000 requires Form 8283 because the amount exceeds $500. Because the amount exceeds $5,000, a qualified appraisal is required under IRC §170(f)(11) and the appraisal summary must be completed in Section B, Part IV. The stock donation is also reported on California Schedule A (540) / Schedule CA (540), Part II, line 12.

fields.name: Charitable contribution carry to Schedule A line 12

review_flags: ACTION REQUIRED: Obtain a qualified appraisal for the $15,000 stock donation before filing; Section B Part IV of Form 8283 must be completed.
Verify the stock was held long-term (more than one year) so the full fair market value is deductible, subject to AGI limitations.
Confirm the donee is a qualified charitable organization under IRC §170(c).
Obtain contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the charity if required.
